info.title: Studio TV Private Library API Extension
info.description: Real private gallery/folder/node aggregates;21 implemented operations, explicit owner/READY assets, revisioned/idempotent transactions. Captured immutable public catalogs are resources extension.

x-reserved-scope: Public publishing, team transfer and pricing

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Hyphenated UUID; uppercase normalized. Owner+libraryCreateItem+key scope, canonical validated body hash. Same key/body returns initial201 receipt; changed body409. Replay rechecks live gallery ownership and visible asset references; deleted root404. Root, references, collection revision and receipt commit atomically.

LibraryItemInput.description: Full editable projection, including for PATCH. mainAssetId omitted/null clears the main image; otherwise it must be in assetIds. No owner/folder/node/URL content is accepted. Kind is immutable after creation.

LibraryItem.description: Own private gallery. IDs are references to authorized READY IMAGE assets only; no vendor URLs or storage keys. Later unavailable references are hidden while stored references remain intact.
